title: Oltre la collina
notes: Restless debut: progressive songwriting, cutting guitars, choirs and censored stories.

title: Nel mondo, una cosa
notes: Orchestral ballads and acoustic guitars: soul voice, gospel choir and a Lennon blues.

title: Il giorno dopo
notes: Minuetto leads a record of bitter ballads, piano and orchestral crescendos.

title: È proprio come vivere
notes: Orchestral melodic pop: introspective ballads, a chanson homage and Agapimu in Greek.

title: Sensi e controsensi
notes: Soul and Italian orchestra intertwine with unusual arrangements and introspective songs.

title: Un altro giorno con me
notes: Commercial orchestral pop, with a Calabrian folk lullaby.

title: Che vuoi che sia... se t'ho aspettato tanto

notes: Libra and Bacalov join driving funk, classical orchestration and psychedelic ballads.

title: Per amarti
notes: Theatrical ballads and pop-rock covers open the collaboration with Fossati.

title: Danza
notes: Fossati's intimate band experiment mixes electric textures, acoustic instruments and dramatic songwriting.

title: Mimì
notes: Self-written return pairs roughened vocals with Oberheim synthesizers, band arrangements and strings.

title: Quante volte... ho contato le stelle
